web.description:
# GLM-4.5
## Quick Start
### SGLang
- FP8

```shell
python3 -m sglang.launch_server \
  --model-path zai-org/GLM-4.5-Air-FP8 \
  --tp-size 4 \
  --tool-call-parser glm45  \
  --reasoning-parser glm45  \
  --speculative-algorithm EAGLE \
  --speculative-num-steps 3  \
  --speculative-eagle-topk 1  \
  --speculative-num-draft-tokens 4 \
  --mem-fraction-static 0.7 \
  --disable-shared-experts-fusion \
  --served-model-name glm-4.5-air-fp8 \
  --host 0.0.0.0 \
  --port 8000
```

web.title: zai-org/GLM-5 · We need Air and we need Flash - Hugging Face
web.description:
## We need Air and we need Flash
This model now no longer fits within 8xH100 and 4xH200 setups at FP8

A model ~100-150B parameters gives the density for general world knowledge and wide range of capabilities, while being small enough for single GPU+CPU setups!

I can only have the access to 8 H100 GPUs, so something at the size of GLM 4.7 for GLM 5 Air would be awesome.

web.title: zai-org/GLM-5-FP8 - Hugging Face
web.description:
# GLM-5-FP8
## Serve GLM-5 Locally
### Deploy
```shell
vllm serve zai-org/GLM-5-FP8 \
       --tensor-parallel-size 8 \
       --gpu-memory-utilization 0.85 \
       --speculative-config.method mtp \
       --speculative-config.num_speculative_tokens 3 \
       --tool-call-parser glm47 \
       --reasoning-parser glm45 \
       --enable-auto-tool-choice \
       --served-model-name glm-5-fp8
```
